title: Publishing safeguards and deployment checks

items.text: Resolve the GitHub integration workflows permission using the supported LifeOS/GitHub configuration; do not add credentials to this repository.

evidence.value: Workflow now runs check:build and check:demos after Astro/Pagefind and before artifact upload; deploy still needs build.
